subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should OpenClaw expose pending exec approval command details through the CLI now, and should the first merge be list/json only or include resolve/watch behavior?
rationale: The backend API exists, but exposing pending command text and possible approval decisions from CLI is an operator security and product boundary rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Ship list/json first
options.body: Expose only pending approval inspection through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and leave resolve/watch for separate review.

options.title: Adopt broader CLI control
options.body: Review and land a broader candidate that includes pending/list plus resolve/respond after live proof and security review.

options.title: Defer CLI exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in UI/SDK paths until maintainers decide the CLI command is worth the operator-risk tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Ship list/json first
recommendation.body: Expose only pending approval inspection through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and leave resolve/watch for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties him to the approvals CLI/docs surface and he already scoped the remaining CLI work in discussion.
